projects.title: NeuroNotes AI
projects.summary: AI-powered note summarizer with semantic search.
projects.description: Built a full-stack app that ingests lecture notes and generates summaries, flashcards, and Q&A using LLMs. Implemented vector search with pgvector for semantic retrieval.

projects.title: Smart Grid Monitor
projects.summary: Real-time energy monitoring with ESP32 and MQTT.
projects.description: Designed a low-cost IoT system to monitor voltage, current, and power factor across multiple nodes. Data streamed via MQTT to a FastAPI backend and visualized in React.

projects.title: 8-bit ALU in Verilog
projects.summary: Designed and simulated an 8-bit ALU using Verilog and Xilinx Vivado.
projects.description: Implemented arithmetic and logic operations, verified with testbenches, and synthesized for FPGA. Achieved 150 MHz clock frequency.

projects.title: DevConnect
projects.summary: A social platform for developers to share projects and find collaborators.
projects.description: Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Tailwind. Features authentication, real-time chat, project showcases, and a recommendation engine.

projects.title: Raspberry Pi NAS
projects.summary: DIY network-attached storage with Raspberry Pi and Samba.
projects.description: Configured a headless Raspberry Pi as a NAS with automated backups, media streaming, and remote access via Tailscale.

projects.title: DSA Visualizer
projects.summary: Interactive visualizations for common data structures and algorithms.
projects.description: Built with React and Framer Motion. Covers sorting, searching, trees, and graphs with step-by-step animations and complexity analysis.
